d:
Dharmik embodies the vibrant essence of South India, celebrating its rich cinema, soulful music, timeless traditions, distinctive style, and iconic celebrities. As a true superstar, he becomes a beacon of cultural pride, bringing people together with his charisma. This song serves as a unifying anthem, inviting everyone to groove to the irresistible beats of South Indian folk music, spreading joy and showcasing the region's dynamic spirit.
Song Credits:
Track Name: South ka superstar
Written & Performed By: DHARMIK
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: DHARMIK
